verdict.summary: The documentation-only change is internally consistent with the workflow and gating policy. The checkout confirms that determinism-gate and a11y-ratchet are separate unconditional jobs, neither is registered advisory, foundation-smoke is advisory, the workflow has pull_request and main-push triggers but no merge_group trigger, and the documented timeout/runtime distinction matches the workflow. The decline rationale is complete and does not alter CI behavior. Injection detection is true because the untrusted diff contains imperative prose ("Do not re-file"); it appears to be a maintainer-facing comment and did not influence this review.
